scope: post-hoc diagnostic analysis of M3-mini K-scaling; no bank rebuild; no model generation
diagnostics: fused-output error as a function of normalized gate entropy
interpretation_rules: M3R is diagnostic only and does not modify M3-mini or formal-v2 primary decisions.
Synthetic gate distributions are used to explain mechanisms, not to claim endpoint quality.
If CoreFlow wins in sparse entropy bins but loses in dense bins, the K-scaling claim must be gate-distribution dependent.
